exposure: daily dosing of gentamicin using ideal body weight
finding: Daily dosing of gentamicin using ideal body weight was associated with a higher rate of successful treatment of chorioamnionitis without the development of endometritis and/or neonatal sepsis compared to traditional dosing.
mod_finding: Women receiving daily gentamicin dosing for chorioamnionitis had a similar Cesarean delivery rate compared to those receiving traditional dosing (39% vs. 37%).
